name: Shoreside Oasis
summary: Our property is the complete package. Starting with the stunning views down the entire cove as you walk into the home, every aspect of your experience here will have Lake Norman as your backdrop. Settle in, but before you get too cozy, head out back and explore all there is to offer - the large deck, giant boat dock, private reading retreat, lakeside firepit, and more. When you’re ready to head inside, log in to the blazing-fast Wi-Fi, enjoy some coffee, and get comfortable.

📸 IG / FB: @nirvanaluxevacations
Seasonal Decor: Will decorate for Fall & Christmas season

**********************************************

Add our listing to your Wishlist by clicking the ♥ in the upper-right corner.

The Perks:
• Breathtaking lake views
• Fully loaded Game room with Arcade games, Pool table, Air Hockey, Foosball table and many board games.
• Abundant outdoor spaces for relaxation and recreation
• Complimentary kayaks for your enjoyment
• Five elegant bedrooms and three and a half lavish baths
• Television sets in nearly every room
• A fully equipped kitchen (complete with coffee provisions)
• Hassle-free keyless entry with a unique code
• Impeccably clean interiors
• On-site parking for up to five vehicles
• Conveniently located within a five-minute drive of grocery and shopping stores

★ LIVING ROOM ★
As you step inside, our living room extends a heartfelt welcome, evoking a genuine sense of home. The plush sofas beckon you to sink into their sumptuous comfort, while the coffee table becomes a gathering point for shared moments. The grandeur of the surroundings is revealed through the expansive windows, framing a captivating view of the lake. When it's time for entertainment, a cutting-edge Smart TV stands ready for movie nights. This space is an invitation to cozy up and craft unforgettable memories with loved ones.
✔ A generously sized window frames an enchanting vista of the lake.
✔ Luxurious sofas, adorned with plump pillows, ensure the ultimate in comfort.
✔ Indulge in your favorite shows and films on the state-of-the-art Smart TV.
✔ Thoughtful decor elements enhance the overall ambiance.
✔ Access to the enclosed lakeside porch completes this exceptional experience.

★ KITCHEN & DINING ★

Our fully appointed kitchen, complemented by an inviting dining area, radiates the ambiance of a charming tavern. Whether you're crafting culinary masterpieces or opting for a cozy, home-cooked meal, this space leaves no desire unfulfilled.
✔ A microwave for swift meal preparation.
✔ A stove and oven for unleashing your culinary creativity.
✔ An abundance of refrigerator and freezer space to store your ingredients.
✔ A Coffee Maker, complete with a selection of coffee blends.
✔ A dishwasher for seamless clean-up.
✔ A comprehensive assortment of trays, glassware, and silverware.
✔ An array of pots and pans to cater to your cooking needs.
✔ A dining table with seating for up to eight guests.

★ Fully loaded Game room ★
✔A game room upstairs loaded with Pool table, Air Hocky, Arcade Games, Foosball table and table overseeing the lake for board games. 
✔ A TV with a sofa to enjoy the sports of your choice with a mood lighting. 

★ SLEEPING SANCTUARIES – 5 BEDROOMS ★

Within our spacious abode, you'll discover tastefully appointed bedrooms that have been designed with your utmost comfort and convenience in mind. They promise a tranquil retreat where you can unwind and rejuvenate after a day of Lake Norman adventures.

♛ Master Bedroom
✔ A luxurious King-Size Bed adorned with plump pillows, linens, and sheets.
✔ An en-suite full bathroom featuring a deep soaking tub and a dual vanity.
✔ Smart TV for your entertainment pleasures.
✔ Nightstand with reading lamps.
✔ A roomy closet complete with hangers.

♛ Bedroom 2
✔ Enjoy a captivating view of the lake.
✔ A comfortable King-Size Bed accompanied by pillows, linens, and sheets.
✔ Attached full bathroom for added convenience.
✔ Smart TV.
✔ Closet with hangers.
✔ Nightstands featuring reading lamps.
✔ This bedroom boasts the most generous dimensions.

♛ Bedroom 3
✔ A serene Queen-Size Bed adorned with pillows, linens, and sheets.
✔ Smart TV.
✔ Closet with hangers.
✔ Nightstands featuring reading lamps.

♛ Bedroom 4
✔ A restful Queen-Size Bed adorned with pillows, linens, and sheets.
✔ Smart TV.
✔ Closet with hangers.
✔ Nightstands featuring reading lamps.

♛ Bedroom 5
✔ This room boasts a unique arrangement with four bunk beds, comfortably accommodating four guests.

✔ Further exploration upon arrival may reveal additional amenities, such as office space or bookshelves.

★ BATHROOMS ★

For your absolute convenience and peace of mind, Shoreside oasis provides three full bathrooms and one half bathroom, all thoughtfully stocked with premium towels and luxurious soaps.

♛ Bathroom 1
✔ Offers the convenience of a combination shower and tub.
✔ Vanity complete with a sink and mirror.
✔ Toilet for your comfort.

♛ Bathroom 2 (Master)

✔ A luxurious shower and a deep soaking tub for your indulgence.
✔ Dual vanity with two sinks and mirrors.
✔ Toilet for your convenience.
♛ Bathroom 3 (Upstairs)
✔ Features the convenience of a combination shower and tub.
✔ Vanity complete with a sink and mirror.
✔ Toilet for your comfort.
♛ Bathroom 4 (Half)
✔ A convenient vanity complete with a sink and mirror.
✔ Toilet for your ease.

★ OUTDOOR OASIS ★
Your lakefront experience awaits, offering an array of exclusive amenities for your enjoyment, all cocooned in privacy from your neighbors.
✔ Multiple Seating Areas, each thoughtfully adorned with tables and chairs.
✔ A spacious deck extending seamlessly from the main living area to the master bedroom.
✔ A charming dock graced with a swinging bench, kayaks, and additional seating.
✔ A private reading nook, providing a serene space for tranquility.
✔ A gas grill for alfresco culinary adventures.
✔ A lakeside fire pit, igniting warm and communal evenings.

★ SAFETY & SECURITY ★
Currently, a surveillance camera oversees the driveway, with plans to bolster safety and security for our cherished guests through the installation of a couple more outdoor cameras during winter of 2023. These cameras will be positioned at the front door, the beginning of the driveway, and the rear of the deck, ensuring comprehensive monitoring of all entry points into the house.

Propane Grill Note:
The property includes a propane grill with a small tank. While our team makes every effort to keep it filled, we cannot guarantee the tank will always last for the duration of your stay. For uninterrupted grilling, guests are welcome to bring an extra propane tank and may take it with them upon departure.

🚭 No Smoking / Vaping Policy

Smoking or vaping of any kind is strictly prohibited anywhere on the property, including indoors, decks, patios, and common areas.

$500 penalty will be imposed for any violations, plus additional cleaning or damage costs if applicable.

🐾 Pet Policy – No Pets Allowed

To ensure a comfortable, clean, and allergen-friendly experience for all guests, pets are not permitted on the property 🧼✨

If any pet is brought onto the property, the following will apply:

• 💲 A $750 unauthorized pet fee will be charged to cover additional cleaning and sanitation
• 🛋️ Guests will be financially responsible for any damage caused by the pet, including (but not limited to) furniture, linens, flooring, or outdoor areas
• 🛠️ Any repair or replacement costs will be charged separately based on actual damages

This policy helps us maintain a high standard of cleanliness and comfort for every guest 🌿🏡
We truly appreciate your understanding and cooperation 🙏


★ UPGRADES & RENOVATIONS ★ -

 Updated as of Jan 27, 2024
Indoor renovations and upgrades were completed in December 2023. We have transformed the bedrooms with new beds, Memory foam mattresses, Linens. Freshly painted the whole house, upgraded décor PLUS added Foosball table, Air Hocky and Three Arcade games for children and adults to have endless fun. The refreshed photos are yet to be added to the listing.

We eagerly anticipate the pleasure of hosting you! Feel free to reach out if you have any questions; we're here with the answers. Happy Travels!

Access is effortless - no keys to lose! You'll receive your exclusive access code, valid for the duration of your stay. Simply arrive for your vacation, and instant access awaits you – it's time to RELAX! This entire home is yours exclusively during your stay.

I will be a quick message, text, or phone call away!

On your drive in, you'll see Lake Norman peaking through between all of the luxury homes. The street is a dead-end and provides a peaceful experience without all of the thru traffic. Grocery and shopping is only 5 minutes away.

There are 5 parking spots on the driveway, and more places to park behind your vehicles - you'll just have to shuffle around if you block in one of your cars. As a bonus, there is a spot for your boat trailer. Incase you do not bring your boat, there is a space for two more cars to park in tandem.

The home is exclusively yours, without interruption for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home.
In addition to the amenities already mentioned, our home is also equipped with:

✔It is important to refrain from moving any furniture or wall hangings to preserve their arrangement and prevent any potential damage.
